pages.zh:
为

土野焦
四十余岁，安徽人。大学毕业，系上海青帮成员，拥有众多党羽。在上海虹口公园刺杀白川大将者是否为其人？被捕者乃其同党。在北火车站袭击宋子文，以及在总司令部门前袭击蒋介石者，亦由其领导。数年前因南京政府发出逮捕令，无法居留上海，遂南下居住于香港。其在香港的住所多达四十余处，持有百余把备用钥匙，每处停留仅数分钟或数小时。除其本人外，无人知晓其安身之所。此前袭击汪精卫一事，亦由其领导，据称费用五万美元，全部由陈铭枢出资。目前此人似在香港处境艰难，因香港政府应南京政府之请正在对其进行搜查，恐怕不日将前往他地。

驻上海日本总领事馆

关于黄野蕉身世及行踪调查事宜

一、王亚樵或陈亚胜（黄野蕉等十九人不知其名）在上海事变期间隶属于第十九路军谭启秀部下，组织“敢死团”，实施多起凶残暴行。因在事变后被免职，遂解散该团，被迫逃往华北热河方面。

二、热河战事后，与何觉然、张根仁等数人潜往广东，在当地及汕头、香港等地致力于为期三周的反日宣传；同时以援助满洲义勇军为名，向各方募集义捐，却将款项用于赌博挥霍。此事终为广东政府所知，遭追捕后潜伏于香港广泰来钱庄，随后前往厦门。

三、昭和十年（1935年）上半年再次现身香港，此后陈亚胜

February 20, 36.

Confidential

Special Political Officer.

Antecedents of Wang Yah Tsiao (王亞樵).

The following further information has been received from the local Japanese Consular Police concerning Wang Yah Tsiao who is reported to have been responsible for the assassination of Mr. Tang Yu Jen, former Vice-Minister of Foreign Affairs:-

Wang Yah Tsiao, a native of Anhwei, over 40 years old, is a university graduate and a member of the Tsing Kiang Group (青江幫) in Shanghai. Wang has a large number of followers. It was he who planned the Hongkew Park Outrage in 1932 which subsequently resulted in the death of General Shirakawa, then Commander-in-Chief of the Japanese Forces in Shanghai. The person who was arrested in connection with this case was a member of his gang. He was also responsible for the attempt on the life of Mr. T.V. Soong at the Shanghai North Railway Station and on General Chiang Kai-Shek in front of the General Headquarters.

Following the issue by the Nanking Government of a warrant for his arrest, Wang escaped to Hankow from **〔此处转录不清〕**

Information regarding the assassination

In connection with the assassination of Mr. Tang Yu Jen,
former Vice-Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Nanking

has been obtained from a certain source:-

An assassination corps has been organized by anti-Chiang
Kai Shek elements of the Cantonese clique under the instruc-

a man named Huang Yah Tsien (黄野燕) who was the Chief of the

armistice, Huang left Shanghai and actively engaged in an

as his base of operations.

Members of the corps are soldiers of the 19th Route Army.
A number of these members were despatched to Shanghai and

关于唐有壬先生遇刺案的情报

关于1935年12月25日南京政府前外交部次长唐有壬先生遇刺案，从某消息来源获得如下情报：-

一个刺客团体已由广东派系中反蒋介石分子在广东政府的指示下组织起来。该团体的首领名为黄野燕，他在1932年上海中日冲突期间曾任十九路军特别队队长。停战后，黄离开上海，以香港为行动基地，积极从事反日和反蒋介石运动。

该团体成员均为十九路军士兵。其中多名成员被派往上海和南京，并与位于香港的总部保持联系。

在唐有壬先生遇刺前一周，一名自称是李济深将军参谋长的人在已故唐有壬先生住所隔壁的

Rue Gaston Kahn and commenced to make preparations to carry out the plot against the life of Mr. Tang. After the assassination the culprits escaped to Hongkong.

It is believed that these men were closely connected with the persons responsible for the murder of the Japanese sailor Nakayama on Darroch Road in November, 1935.

The Shanghai Branch of the Assassination Corps is reported to be located on the 1st floor of a rice shop at the corner of Avenue Edward VII and Chengtu Road.

At my request, the local Japanese Consular Authorities have furnished me with the following result of their investigation:

Wong Yah Chiau (王亞樵) (not Huang Yah Tsiau 黃野) alias Zung Yah Sheng (陳亞勝) was under Tang Chi Siao (譚啓秀) of the 19th Route Army during the Sino-Japanese hostilities in Shanghai in 1932. As Wong was the organiser of a gang which had committed numerous atrocities during the trouble, he was dismissed on the cessation of hostilities. Consequently the gang was dissolved and Wong left for North China and Jehol. After the fighting between the Japanese and Chinese forces in Jehol, he proceeded to Canton together with a number of his colleagues including Ho Chak Zen (何覺然) and Tsang Kang Zah (張根仁) and visited Swatow and Hankow. In the course of his visits, he took an active part in anti-Japanese propaganda. He also collected funds for the purpose of supporting the Volunteer Corps in Manchuria but he squandered the money in gambling. Upon this being discovered by the Canton Authorities he decamped to Hongkong where he lived in hiding at the Tung Tai Lai Hotel (東泰來). Later he left for Amoy.

Early in 1933, he again went to Hongkong and lived with one of his friends at No.16 Yan Yin Street (晏陰街), Happy Valley. He is reported to have been engaged in trafficking in firearms. In July, 1933, he proceeded to Macao where he is staying at No.11 or No.41 Rua Lobo Street (羅保街). It appears that he is not a paid assassin.

相信这些人与1935年11月在达罗克路（Darroch Road）谋杀日本水兵中山一案的责任人有着密切联系。

据报道，该刺客团体的上海分部位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）与成都路转角处的一家米店二楼。

应我要求，当地日本领事当局向我提供了其调查结果如下：

王亚樵（非黄野）别名陈亚胜，在1932年上海中日冲突期间隶属于十九路军谭启秀部下。由于王是那个在动乱期间犯下无数暴行的帮派的组织者，他在战事停止后被解职。因此该帮派解散，王前往华北及热河。在日军与中国军队在热河交战后，他与包括何觉然和张根仁在内的一些同事一起前往广东，并访问了汕头和汉口。在访问期间，他积极参与反日宣传。他还为支持满洲义勇军募集资金，但他将钱款挥霍于赌博。此事被广东当局发现后，他潜逃至香港，隐居于东泰来酒店。后来他前往厦门。

1933年初，他再次前往香港，与一位朋友住在跑马地晏阴街16号。据报他从事枪支贩卖活动。1933年7月，他前往澳门，住在罗保街11号或41号。看来他并非受雇的职业刺客。

March 30, 1936. Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram):

THE ATTEMPT ON LIFE OF MR. WAUNG CHING WEI

According to the statements made by Chang Yu Hwa (張玉華) and Woo Poo Kwang (賀坡光), the two men involved in the attempted assassination of Waung Ching Wei, ex-President of the Executive Yuan, the instigators are General Chen Min Hsu (陳敏) and General Li Chi Sen (李濟深). The persons who carried out the plot on the instructions of Generals Chen and Li were Wang Ah Chiao (王亞樵), Yu Lih Kwei (余立奎), and Hwa Kuh Ts (華克之). These three men had an assassination headquarters at Hongkong. They were also responsible for the attempted assassination of Mr.T.V. Soong, ex-Minister of Finance, which took place some time ago at the Shanghai North Railway Station and resulted in the death of Mr. Soong's secretary and a body-guard. They also made attempts on the members of the Investigation Commission of the League of Nations which came to China.

Yu Lih Kwei was not only present when the attempted assassination of T. V. Soong took place, but he directed it. Wang Ah Chiao had many followers of whom the most important are: Chow Shih Ping (周世平), Hu Dah Hai (胡大海), Chang Chi Han (張紀漢) etc. who frequented the assassination headquarters at Hongkong and planned assassinations on behalf of Wang Ah Chiao. They had an active part in the attempted assassination of Waung Ching Wei.

The Chinese Government immediately communicated with the Hongkong Government and requested the arrest of these persons, while officials were detailed to the addresses furnished by the men under arrest. Thus, Yu Lih Kwei, Hu Dah Hai, Chow Shih Ping and Chang Chi Han were apprehended. A quantity of evidence relating to several cases of assassination were seized at the headquarters by the Hongkong Government. The arrested men and the evidence will be handed over to the Chinese Authorities in the near future.

It is understood that the 5th Branch of the Kiangsu High Court will frame charges against the four accused as soon as they have been handed over by the Hongkong Government.

The following statement was made by Chang Yu Hwa (one of the arrested men) on November 18 last year at Nanking Metropolitan Police Headquarters:-

"The principals in the attempted assassination of Waung Ching Wei are Wang Ah Chiao, Yu Lih Kwei and Hwa Kuh Ts. I used the alias of Li Shih An (李世安). All the plans relating to this attempted assassination of Waung Ching Wei were carried out on the instructions of Hwa Kuh Ts, Wang Ah Chiao and Yu Lih Kwei. The plot was laid before or after the January 28 Incident at the home of Yu Lih Kwei at Shanghai when Wang Ah Chiao, Yu Lih Kwei, Sung Voong Ming (宋雲明), Hsu Chih Yuan (許志遠), Wang's uncle and I were present.

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸（南京电）：

汪精卫先生遇刺未遂案

据参与刺杀前行政院长汪精卫未遂的两名男子张玉华和贺坡光供述，主谋者为陈敏将军和李济深将军。奉陈、李二将军指令执行该阴谋者为王亚樵、余立奎和华克之。这三人在香港设有一个刺客总部。他们还应对此前发生在上海北站的刺杀前财政部长宋子文先生未遂事件负责，该事件导致宋先生的秘书和一名保镖死亡。他们还曾企图刺杀来华的国际联盟调查团成员。

余立奎不仅在宋子文遇刺未遂事件发生时在场，而且指挥了该行动。王亚樵拥有许多追随者，其中最重要的是周世平、胡大海、张纪汉等，这些人经常出入香港的刺客总部，并代表王亚樵策划暗杀。他们在刺杀汪精卫未遂事件中发挥了积极作用。

中国政府立即与香港政府联系，请求逮捕这些人，同时派遣官员前往被捕者提供的地址。因此，余立奎、胡大海、周世平和张纪汉被抓获。香港政府在总部查获了大量涉及几起暗杀案件的证据。被捕人员和证据将在近期移交给中国当局。

据悉，江苏高等法院第五分院将在香港政府移交这四名被告后立即对他们提起诉讼。

去年11月18日，张玉华（被捕者之一）在南京首都警察厅总部作出如下陈述：-

“刺杀汪精卫未遂案的主犯是王亚樵、余立奎和华克之。我使用的化名是李世安。所有关于这次刺杀汪精卫未遂的计划都是奉华克之、王亚樵和余立奎的指令执行的。该阴谋是在‘一·二八’事变前后，在上海余立奎家中策划的，当时在场的有王亚樵、余立奎、宋云明、许志远、王的叔叔和我。

“奉王亚樵、余立奎和华克之的指令，我和贺坡光前往

Central Kuomintang Headquarters during the 5th Plenary
Session in November 1934 and attempted the assassination
of General Chiang Kai Shek. Sung Voong Ming carried a
pistol. Owing to a tooth-ache, General Chiang left
the Session before its termination. We saw General
Chiang Kai Shek enter his car, but as we had not yet decided
whether or not to assassinate him, we took no action
against him. Wang Ah Chiao and Yu Lih Kwei were very
dissatisfied and detailed Hwa Kuh Ts to Nanking to question
us. This Spring (1935) Sung Voong Ming, Kwoh Wei
Tsoong (郭維忠) and I were ordered to Hongkong to
interview Yu Lih Kwei. We went and upon our return
to Nanking we were determined to make the attempted
assassination during the 6th Plenary Session of the
Kuomintang. One week prior to the attempt, Hwa Kuh
Ts accompanied by Sung Voong Ming came to Nanking. The
assassination was directed against Waung Ching Wei and
General Chiang Kai Shek. As General Chiang was not
present, we made the attempt on the life of Waung Ching
Wei. If General Chiang Kai Shek had been present
he would not have escaped unhurt. Wang's confederates in
Shanghai were Tsai Tao Ho (蔡道和), Hsu Chi Yuan, Hwa
Kuh Ts, Lin Dah Hai, Chow Shih Ping, Chang Chi Han,
Wang Ah Chiao and Chang Yu Hwa, of whom the last five
named have left Shanghai and gone to live in Hongkong.
At ordinary times they arranged for assassinations; they
showed extra energy in the attempt on the life of Waung
Ching Wei."
The statement was read out to the prisoner who,
having admitted that it was correct, signed and affixed
his fingerprint to it.

1934年11月国民党五中全会期间的中央党部，企图刺杀蒋介石将军。宋云明携带了一支手枪。由于牙痛，蒋介石将军在会议结束前离开。我们看到蒋介石将军进入他的汽车，但由于我们尚未决定是否刺杀他，我们没有对他采取行动。王亚樵和余立奎非常不满，并派遣华克之到南京质问我们。今年春天（1935年），宋云明、郭维忠和我奉命前往香港会见余立奎。我们去过之后，回到南京，便决心在国民党六中全会期间实施刺杀未遂行动。在行动前一周，华克之陪同宋云明来到南京。刺杀的目标是汪精卫和蒋介石将军。由于蒋介石将军不在场，我们转而试图刺杀汪精卫。如果蒋介石将军在场，他也不会毫发无损。王在上海的同伙有蔡道和、许志远、华克之、林大海、周世平、张纪汉、王亚樵和张玉华，其中最后五人已离开上海，前往香港居住。平时他们安排暗杀活动；在试图刺杀汪精卫的行动中，他们表现得格外积极。”
该陈述向囚犯宣读，囚犯承认属实，并在上面签字并按下手印。
